card.title: How To Fix iPhone 4S That Is Bootlooping With iTunes Error 29

source.title: How To Fix iPhone 4S That Is Bootlooping With iTunes Error 29

claims.statement: iPhone 4S bootlooping and failing updates with error 29 (iTunes ~60%, 3uTools at 80% 'Updating GasGauge') is often a low-quality replacement battery or a missing R61 near the battery connector (liquid damage).
Replace R61; a jumper across its pads works for data recovery only.

procedure: Inspect near the battery connector for missing R61.
Replace R61 (or temporary jumper for data).
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
